title: BURP
tagline: Unique agent-driven clusters for safer, diversified crypto investments.

prizes.title: Best Overall Transformative Use of PYUSD

description:
BURP is a decentralised AI-powered crypto investment platform that automates portfolio management through autonomous agents. Users authenticate via wallet, complete minimal KYC verification, and interact directly with AI agents to create and manage diversified crypto portfolios using PYUSD as the primary settlement currency.

How BURP Works

1. Wallet Authentication → Connect your Web3 wallet (MetaMask, WalletConnect) for instant access. No traditional signup required.

2. Privacy-First KYC → Complete age verification using Self Protocol's zero-knowledge proof system in under 30 seconds.

3. AI Agent Chat → Communicate directly with specialised AI agents through a chat interface to discuss investment preferences and risk tolerance.

4. Automated Portfolio Creation → AI agents automatically generate a diversified crypto portfolio cluster with optimised asset weightings based on your preferences.

5. PYUSD-Only Operations → All transactions happen in PYUSD - funding, trading, rebalancing, profit distribution, and withdrawals for seamless global access.

Key Benefits

- Zero Complexity: Chat with AI agents instead of learning complex DeFi protocols
- Automated Management: AI handles all portfolio optimisation and rebalancing 24/7
- Global Access: PYUSD enables worldwide participation without traditional banking barriers
- Privacy Protection: Zero-knowledge KYC maintains compliance without exposing personal data
- Institutional-Grade: Sophisticated portfolio management previously only available to large investors

BURP transforms crypto investing from manual trading to intelligent automation - connect wallet, verify age, chat with AI, and let autonomous agents manage your diversified portfolio using PYUSD.
how_its_made:
BURP is deployed on Fluence VM as a complete decentralized AI-powered investment platform. The frontend React application (Material-UI, MetaMask
  integration) communicates with a Node.js/Express backend featuring MongoDB Atlas for user management and portfolio tracking. AI agents powered by OpenAI and SELF Protocol run autonomously on
  Fluence's distributed compute infrastructure, generating personalized investment baskets through natural language chat interfaces. Smart contracts (ClusterBasket.sol, ClusterDEX.sol,
  ClusterPricing.sol) integrate 1inch DEX aggregation for optimal trade execution, Pyth Network oracles for real-time pricing, and PayPal PyUSD for mainstream payment settlement. The platform
  leverages Fluence VM's decentralized compute capabilities to ensure AI agents operate without centralized dependencies, while maintaining full sponsor integrations through standardized APIs.
  Authentication flows use MetaMask signature verification with JWT session management, enabling seamless wallet-based access to AI-generated DeFi portfolios with automated rebalancing and real-time
   monitoring across the decentralized infrastructure.
